changed_current_carriers.current_claim_summary: Current Claim says Workflow defines a graph of Steps, distinguishes Runtime vs Project Purpose selections, and describes Purpose ownership semantics. Rebase before guarded write; this meaning differs materially from earlier basis.
Current prose explicitly specifies endpoint-local Relation bounds, Node-specific claims, and := as allowed-value plus condition syntax.
Current Formal Claim defines CFEL Operator//SubjectValueSelection as := and says this combines admitted Property value with selection.
Current Declaration defines Workflow/(.Purpose := Runtime) as a Runtime Workflow and records inheritance from Workflow.
Current Declaration defines Workflow/(.Purpose := Project) as a Project Workflow and records inheritance from Workflow.
